title: The Highest Loop — swyx
talk_summary: This is a conference-opening keynote about the meta-concept of 'loops' (token→chat→tools→goals→automations) and about the human/community loop as the 'highest loop' that generates new loops. It contains no engineering mechanisms, measurements, or implementation details—only framing and event promotion.

takeaways.technique: Loop-level abstraction as a debugging heuristic
takeaways.what_they_do: Frames agent work as a stack of nested loops; when quality/reliability issues appear, 'go down a loop' to the lower-level mechanism, and when scaling, 'go up a loop' to a higher abstraction.
takeaways.evidence_quote: when you're finding issues, going down a loop and going lower level in order to figure out reliability
